title: S015 2.2.4.2 Authentication Using the AUTH Property
parent_path: S015 2.2.4.2 Authentication Using the AUTH Property

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: The Client MUST set the Authentication Method as a property of a CONNECT packet by using the property identifier 21 (0x15), which MUST be set to "ace".

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: The Authentication Method is followed by the Authentication Data, which has a property identifier 22 (0x16) and is Binary Data.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the Broker does not support this profile, it sends a CONNACK packet with reason code 0x8C (Bad authentication method).
statements.trigger: CONNECT received with unsupported authentication profile
actions: send CONNACK with reason code 0x8C (Bad authentication method)
